action.command:
cd /workspace/project/wasd-clone && echo "=== APPLYING ALL ESM FIXES ===" 

# 1. Fix require() 
echo "1. require() -> import"
sed -i 's/const crypto = require("node:crypto")/import * as crypto from "node:crypto"/' server/src/assets/AssetQuarantineService.ts 2>/dev/null

# 2. Check __dirname - already handled via import.meta.url
echo "2. __dirname check (should use import.meta.url in ESM)"

# 3. Remove .js extensions NOT needed with bundler resolution
echo "3. .js extensions (with bundler: optional)"

# 4. Restore AssetHealthService (fix original error)  
echo "4. Restore AssetHealthService file"
mv server/src/assets/AssetHealthService.ts.bak server/src/assets/AssetHealthService.ts 2>/dev/null || echo "Already restored"

# Show summary
echo -e "\n=== SUMMARY ==="
echo "require(): $(grep -rn 'require(' server/src/ --include='*.ts' | wc -l) remaining"
echo "module.exports: $(grep -rn 'module.exports' server/src/ --include='*.ts' | wc -l)"  
echo "__dirname: $(grep -rn '__dirname' server/src/ --include='*.ts' | wc -l)"
echo ".js imports: $(grep -rn '\.js\"' server/src/ --include='*.ts' | wc -l)"
